notes.title: Gloomy Eyes celebrates release on Oculus Quest
notes.notes:
We are so excited to share that the VR film that star Colin Farrell calls "one of the most beautiful things" he has ever been a part of, is now available on Oculus Quest!

Dive into the fantastically eerie and adorably spinning world of Gloomy, a boy zombie different from all the others - one with a heart that yearns for love. In a world flooded with darkness, it is the unexpected connection between a human girl and a zombie boy that inspires hope in all of us. 

Gloomy Eyes holds multiple awards from renowned film festivals across the world including Sundance, Annecy, SXSW, Annie Awards, Venice International, and Raindance.
